{{Top|leg}}
A '''neuro-computer jack''' was a connection device that allowed an individual to download data directly in their [[Brain/Legends|brain]]. [[High Lord]] [[Galen Panos]] of [[House Reena/Legends|House Reena]] had a neuro-computer jack, which was a closely guarded secret for fear of other [[Tapani Noble Houses|Houses]] using it to infuence Panos' thinking with specially designed [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programs.<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
